sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bregon is one old form of the name Breogan. This hero was a leader of the Milesians in the account of the ancient records. He raised a high tower on a far western shore. From the top of the tower his son Ith first saw the isle of Ireland across the water. That spark of a vision drew the Milesians at last to the land. So the tower holds a place in the founding tale of Irish story.

okr.objective: Describe the hero Bregon and the tower he built.
key_results: Bregon is another form of the name Breogan.
He led the Milesians who came to Ireland.
He raised a tall tower on the western shore.
His son Ith saw Ireland from that height.
